verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents automations that run unattended: event-triggered flows send notifications, its AI pricing tier lists "Schedule recurring tasks," and Customer Agent can "send an update automatically." The evidence comes mostly from pricing and marketing snippets, and Composer is described as working "for your review" and "with you in control," so how autonomous AI-configured automations really are is not established. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on configuring flows and recurring schedules, documentation of agent-created automations running without human approval, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Merchants can set up flows based on Klaviyo events to send out branded notifications to both the [gift] recipient and the customer.
use the drag-and-drop email/SMS editors and build automations, segmentation and reports.
When a customer asks where their order is, Customer Agent can find the order, check the status, and send an update automatically.
